metadata.name: Historical synthetic request-to-quote test fixture
metadata.thesis: Synthetic test scenario for exercising graph rules. All records, prices, and findings below are test inputs.

nodes.label: Inbound requests wait days for a scope brief

provenance.method: Synthetic test input. No interviews, payments or customer records.

nodes.evaluation: Ask five firms for the median hours between an inbound request and a written scope. If the median is under four hours, this problem is not real.

data.demandClaim: Owners handle scoping themselves in the evening, so requests sit unanswered through the working day.

nodes.label: Owner-operator of a 3-12 person renovation firm

provenance.method: Synthetic test input. No interviews, payments or customer records.

nodes.evaluation: Ten discovery calls. If fewer than three describe scoping as their bottleneck in their own words, the segment is wrong.

data.demandClaim: This owner will pay per scope brief rather than hire an estimator.

nodes.label: Simulated turnaround observation

provenance.method: Synthetic test input. No interviews, payments or customer records.

nodes.evaluation: Re-verify the dossier entry each quarter; drop the claim if the source is withdrawn or cannot be reproduced.

data.finding: This synthetic example assigns a sample delay to exercise evidence and planning rules.

nodes.label: Simulated price preference

provenance.method: Synthetic test input. No interviews, payments or customer records.

nodes.evaluation: Replace with a paid order. A stated price is not a paid price; this node is downgraded the moment a real invoice exists.

data.finding: This synthetic example assigns a sample preference to exercise demand evidence validation.

nodes.label: One reviewed scope brief per inbound request

provenance.method: Synthetic test input. No interviews, payments or customer records.

nodes.evaluation: The buyer accepts the brief without rewriting it. A brief that is rewritten before use did not deliver the outcome.

data.demandClaim: A per-brief price is approvable without a procurement conversation.

nodes.label: Regional trade association member lists and direct outreach

provenance.method: Synthetic test input. No interviews, payments or customer records.

nodes.evaluation: Twenty contacts produce at least two discovery calls, or the channel does not reach this buyer.

nodes.label: Request to reviewed scope brief

provenance.method: Synthetic test input. No interviews, payments or customer records.

nodes.evaluation: Ten requests run end to end with no step completed outside its stated actor and no gate bypassed.

steps.action: Structure the inbound request against the request schema
List the missing facts that block a scope brief
Draft the scope brief with acceptance checks and non-goals
Estimate implementation effort in hours, without pricing it
Send the reviewed brief to the customer

nodes.label: Scope drafter

provenance.method: Synthetic test input. No interviews, payments or customer records.

nodes.evaluation: Read the run log weekly. Any action outside allowedActions revokes the role until the cause is fixed.

nodes.label: Example owner

provenance.method: Synthetic test input. No interviews, payments or customer records.

nodes.evaluation: Reachable within a working day, and the release log shows this person, not an agent, releasing every gate.

nodes.label: Release before anything reaches the customer

provenance.method: Synthetic test input. No interviews, payments or customer records.

nodes.evaluation: Every delivered brief has a recorded release by the named approver, timestamped before delivery.

nodes.label: Scope brief template and acceptance-check library

provenance.method: Synthetic test input. No interviews, payments or customer records.

nodes.evaluation: A brief produced from the template needs no structural edit before review.

nodes.label: Model usage and hosting

provenance.method: Synthetic test input. No interviews, payments or customer records.

nodes.evaluation: Compare against the provider invoice monthly. A variance above 25 percent invalidates the break-even number.

nodes.label: Founder review and release time

provenance.method: Synthetic test input. No interviews, payments or customer records.

nodes.evaluation: Time the next ten releases. If the median exceeds 30 minutes per brief, the workflow is not carrying its share.

nodes.label: Ten outreach conversations against one channel

provenance.method: Synthetic test input. No interviews, payments or customer records.

nodes.evaluation: The experiment is complete when ten contacts have answered or declined, not when ten messages are sent.

data.hypothesis: At least two of ten contacted firms will accept a paid first brief.
data.decisionRule: Fewer than two acceptances ends the outreach and sends the thesis back to the problem node.

nodes.label: A brief is read as a binding estimate

provenance.method: Synthetic test input. No interviews, payments or customer records.

nodes.evaluation: Every delivered brief carries the non-binding statement and the named human sender.

nodes.label: Review the template against delivered briefs

provenance.method: Synthetic test input. No interviews, payments or customer records.

nodes.evaluation: The review happens on cadence or the asset is marked stale on the surface that uses it.

nodes.label: No paid brief after the first ten conversations

provenance.method: Synthetic test input. No interviews, payments or customer records.

nodes.evaluation: Checked on the review date against paid invoices only. Interest, replies, and calls do not count.

data.threshold: Zero paid briefs after ten completed conversations
